**Forward Deployed Engineer \| Palantir\-style FDE at a software holdco backed by the Collisons, General Catalyst \& D1 \| New York / SF / Toronto (Hybrid) \| $185K–$240K base** 




  





 We've partnered with a new kind of software holding company: one that buys great vertical\-market software businesses and holds them permanently, then grows them with agentic AI rather than financial engineering. They recently closed a $250M Series B from an exceptional roster, including General Catalyst, D1 Capital, CPMG, Sator Grove and the family offices of some of tech's most successful founders, among them Patrick and John Collison, Tony Xu, Eric Glyman and Karim Atiyeh. The founders have done it before: one a former President of Instacart, the other a former Sequoia partner. They run on permanent, committed capital with no pressure to sell, and one clear thesis, scale through software, not headcount.
 



  





 This is a rare Palantir\-style Forward Deployed Engineer role, and the leverage is unusual. You won't write decks. You'll drop into a company that already has customers and revenue, work out which two or three workflows agentic software can genuinely fix, then build it: integrations, prompts, evals, the interface people actually use. You ship it into live operations, tune the autonomy tiers until it runs without anyone hovering, and hand it off clean. Then you write down what you learned, and the next deployment in that vertical goes faster because you did the work first. The difference from selling software is that the customer is a company they own, so if it doesn't work, they feel it directly.
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
 



  





 Drop into a portfolio company, learn how it actually runs, earn the operators' trust, and find the two or three highest\-leverage workflows for agentic software.
 



 Build the wedge: the integrations, prompts, evals and UI to land the first agentic loop on the core platform.
 



 Operate and tune deployed systems after launch, adjusting autonomy tiers and handing off cleanly once stable.
 



 Act as the technical face to portfolio\-company GMs, setting expectations and making the system their leverage.
 



 Bring patterns back to HQ and codify them into playbooks that speed up every future deployment in the vertical.
 



  





 About You
 



  





 You have four to six years of experience, with three the absolute floor and we mean it. Big Tech alone won't clear the bar; the strongest profiles pair a recognisable company with real high\-growth startup experience.
 



 You have genuine tenure at a startup people have heard of, and stayed long enough to watch your own decisions play out. A string of sub\-year stints is the most common reason strong engineers get passed on here.
 



 You can own delivery solo, database through to screen: TypeScript or Python on the backend, React on the frontend, SQL. Specialists get blocked constantly in this role.
 



 You have shipped production LLM or agentic software that external users depended on, with evals, autonomy gating and outcome tracking, not prototypes or demos.
 



 You build with AI dev tools every day and have opinions about them, whether that's Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot or MCP servers. If you don't work this way, the pace will be uncomfortable.
 



 You have operator instincts: you can read a P\&L, sit with a GM who has never written code, disagree, be right, and leave with a scoped technical problem.
 



 You are based in or willing to relocate to New York, San Francisco or Toronto, comfortable with at least three days a week in office plus two to three days travelling to portfolio sites. Open to visa transfers including OPT and H\-1B, with relocation help.
 



  





 The interview will ask you to walk through the hardest technical decision you've made: the decision, the option you turned down, and why. Come ready to go three layers into something you built. The team is hiring several engineers and moving quickly. If you want to ship agentic software into live operations and own the outcomes across an entire portfolio, apply now or send your CV directly to will@inventurerecruitment.com.

 Reporting to the Software Engineering Team Manager, incumbent takes part of an agile development team, building and working on enterprise grade hybrid cloud software systems using a variety of software technologies that include, but not limited to JavaScript, HTML, CSS, C\#, and Microsoft .NET. The incumbent works alongside and receives mentorship from a team of other developers in creating, maintaining, and updating our websites and services with an increased focus on backend, middleware, and cloud infrastructure. The incumbent also provides mentorship to Web Developers and Senior Web Developers while maintaining and updating our websites and services.
   

  

**Work Schedule:** 
 This is a hybrid position. Employees are expected to work
 **three days per week in the office and two days per week remotely** 
 , subject to business needs.
   

  

**Visa Sponsorship:** 
**Salt Lake City Corporation does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.** 
 Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.
   

  

**POSITION SALARY RANGE**
**$90,017 \- $155,800**
**This Position Is Eligible For Full City Benefits, Including**
* Health Insurance
* Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
* Paid vacation and personal leave
* 6\-12 weeks of paid parental leave available
* Retirement contributions toward a pension plan and/or 401(k)
* A robust Employee Assistance Plan (EAP)
* Up to $4,000 tuition reimbursement annually
* Discounted supplemental benefits like pet insurance and legal services


**Typical Duties**
* Website and software application designing, building, or maintaining.
* Coding, testing, and deploying full stack ASP.NET MVC web applications.
* Coding and testing .NET middleware.
* Coding and testing reusable .NET libraries.
* Designing, coding, testing, and deploying REST APIs.
* Designing database table structures and optimizing query performance.
* Designing, building, and maintaining web Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) using REST and Open API best practices.
* Using scripting or authoring languages, management tools, content creation tools, applications, and digital media.
* Conferring with teams to resolve conflicts, prioritize needs, develop content criteria, or choose solutions.
* Developing or validating test routines and schedules to ensure that test cases mimic external interfaces and address all browser and device types.
* Able to develop ideas and processes and clearly express them.
* Maintaining an understanding of the latest web applications and programming practices through education, study, and participation in conferences, workshops, and groups.
* Identifying problems uncovered by customer feedback and testing and correcting or referring problems to appropriate personnel for correction.
* Evaluating code to ensure it meets industry standards, is valid, is properly structured, and is compatible with browsers, devices, or operating systems.
* Determining user needs by analyzing technical requirements.
* Participate in peer\-reviews of solution designs and related code.


**Core Competencies**
* Experience applying and mentoring JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS, C\#, .NET, JSON, XML.
* Experience applying and mentoring HTTP methods.
* Experience applying and mentoring consumption of REST, SOAP, WCF, and OpenAPI.
* Experience applying and mentoring use of JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
* Experience using and teaching basic and advanced Git source control.
* Experience processing Git pull requests.
* Experience with client\-side debugging and profiling using Chrome Developer Tools
* Experienced in server\-side coding and debugging using Microsoft Visual Studio and VS Code.
* Experience using web proxy tools such as Postman and Fiddler.
* Experience in responsive web design.
* Experience in full\-stack development using ASP.NET MVC.
* Experience in secure coding for web applications including CORS, CSRF, and XSS strategies.
* Experience applying mentoring, leadership, and management skills.


**Skill Development**
* Incumbents will be mentored to acquire the following skills through on\-the\-job training and real\-world projects that will also prepare the incumbent for career advancement.
* Azure resource provisioning and management
* Azure API management design and implementation
* Azure SQL and SQL Server Administration
* Azure configuration management resources
* Hybrid cloud integration design and implementation


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or closely related field and a minimum of three (3\) years’ experience in the development and implementation of web applications.
* Possess CompTia Security\+ certification or obtain certification within 6 months.
* Demonstrated sprint planning experience.
* Demonstrated English verbal and written communication skills to communicate with both internal team members and external business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Agile Scrum methodologies.
* Experience with full\-stack ASP.NET MVC application.
* Experience with serverless cloud resources such as Microsoft Azure.


**Working Conditions**
* Light to moderate physical activity. Majority of work is performed in office environment with occasional travel to other city offices.
* Exposure to stressful situations resulting from the demands of critical IT service delivery outages and schedules.

 Based on demonstrated job knowledge, skill, and ability to successfully perform assigned tasks and duties, incumbent may be advanced to Senior Software Engineer.
